query_audio_generation: query the HuggingFace MusicGen API with a text prompt to generate audio and retrieve the audio data and sampling rate
create_headers_auth: create an Authorization header with a Bearer token from the HF_TOKEN environment variable for HuggingFace API requests
post_request_inference: post a JSON payload to the HuggingFace inference API endpoint to generate audio from text input
parse_response_json: parse the JSON response from the HuggingFace inference API to extract audio data and sampling rate
display_audio_ipython: display generated audio using IPython.display.Audio with the audio bytes and sampling rate
